name: 55-tighten-loose-checks
prompt: Every file in v/ has a Validate function. Some just 'return true', which accepts anything. Replace each of those bodies with 'return len(s) > 0 && len(s) < 100' so every validator is strict. Leave the ones that are already strict alone. The package must build.
check: ! grep -rq 'return true' v/ && test $(grep -rc 'len(s) > 0' v/ | grep -c ':1') -eq 12 && go build ./...
